## Reconciliation rule

Do not rename files to resemble production and do not mark unexecuted SQL as
applied. Preserve this receipt, snapshot the effective live schema after the
closure migrations land, apply that baseline to the isolated project, then
start its migration ledger with the baseline checksum and subsequent migrations.
